decision_points.question: Search which records?
decision_points.subject: default

options.label: Recommended default
options.outcome: Global title and notes across every Action including deferred/completed/dropped; exclude Project/Tag records, metadata, collaboration records and hidden IDs.

user_impact: Global title and notes across every Action including deferred/completed/dropped; exclude Project/Tag records, metadata, collaboration records and hidden IDs.

provenance.rationale: User explicitly approved the proposed global Action title/Notes search on 2026-10-31; prior incomplete evaluation is not approval.

decision_points.question: How does query text match?
decision_points.subject: default

options.label: Recommended default
options.outcome: Trim query edges, apply Unicode NFKC and lowercase to query and each field, and match the whole normalized query as a literal contiguous substring within title OR notes. Empty/whitespace query shows no search results. No token operators, fuzzy, accent folding or cross-field concatenation.

user_impact: Trim query edges, apply Unicode NFKC and lowercase to query and each field, and match the whole normalized query as a literal contiguous substring within title OR notes. Empty/whitespace query shows no search results. No token operators, fuzzy, accent folding or cross-field concatenation.

provenance.rationale: User explicitly approved the proposed global Action title/Notes search on 2026-10-31; prior incomplete evaluation is not approval.

flows.name: Find an Action and continue work
steps: [pointer/keyboard/touch] Activate the visible named Search magnifier; focus enters the named search input.
[keyboard/IME] Enter a literal query; view flat matching Actions without moving focus.
[pointer/keyboard/touch] Open a result in existing Detail; narrow Back returns to retained query/results.
[pointer/keyboard/touch] Clear retains search; Close or noncomposing Escape restores prior navigation and focuses Search; selecting navigation exits to that destination.

interaction_rules.condition: Search is entered, edited, refreshed or exited

Existing inspector remains reachable when its edited row stops matching.

delivery_slices.goal: Global search with all ten scenarios; one bounded shared UI implementation unit.

observable_state_contracts.subject: Search navigation and results

transitions.trigger: Enter query with available matching data

invariants: Clear does not exit; close restores prior view settings; navigation exits to selected destination.
Failure retains available accepted snapshot and error/retry; unavailable data is never successful zero results.
All open search states permit close and navigation without dropping draft/recovery state.

design_handoffs.required_outcome: One shared pure search projection, aligned selection/movement, controller-owned retained state and IME-safe DOM effects.
design_obligations: Define model types and pure title/notes normalization, draft overlay and flat canonical unique rows.
Controller owns search state, prior navigation, draft retention, latest accepted refresh, exact unknown request and explicit focus effects; rendering cannot initialize state.
Align controller, DOM and move-chooser projections; normalize visible explicit selection while retaining independent active inspector; exclude ambiguous filtered drop destinations.
Compose shared factories in client/generated resource and retain keyed input/caret through typing/IME.
Scope exact files after code assessment; update relevant UI architecture/reference docs with current behavior; no backend/schema work.
verification_obligations: Pure model tests discriminate scope, normalization, no mutation, uniqueness/order and drafts.
Application/mock-port tests prove navigation/detail/refresh, raw proposal retention, hidden selection and exact unknown request recovery.
Generated shared HTML DOM tests prove named controls, stable focus/caret/IME, result activation and narrow layout; real browser/host assistive acceptance remains explicit if unavailable.
Run pnpm check and pnpm build; report failures/skips and actual-host limitations without claiming unperformed acceptance.

provenance.rationale: Preserve established pure-model/controller/effect and presentation responsibilities while implementing confirmed UX.
